agent.problem: The opening card identifies the teacher and introduces the warning, but it never says whom the teacher is addressing. "Friend" is Papa Dorin addressing the baker, not the audience of the sayings.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on.

agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the introduction of the plotters, the statement about schemers and a foolish scheme, and the line about calling it sin.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: This card only reacts to verse 20 after card 10 has already asked about it. The "Lights OUT" line and junk-drawer joke add no new passage movement before the walkthrough proceeds to verse 21.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

agent.problem: The question presupposes that the rebellious bring the destruction described in verse 22. The verse says only that "they" will bring sudden destruction; the card turns that pronoun into a specific claim about the rebellious rather than leaving the antecedent open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
